payload.title: Lab transformer C2: Firewall for pasted URLs
payload.description:
A primed example's canonical source URL must not match any item the publication decides (checked at transform completion and at accept).
Acceptance: spec covering both checkpoints.

Size: M
Dependencies: C1
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (decision-flywheel-1b8b860d). Related: hosted curation epic decision-flywheel-1da33407.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.
